visualVerdict.explanation: Both screenshots correct. Screenshot 1 (price 25, qty 10): revenue line reaches 500 at q=20 (25×20), passes through 250 at q=10; total cost from 100 to 300 (100+10q), point at 200 at q=10; profit 50 (profit), matching revenue>cost. Screenshot 2 (price 20, qty 10): revenue reaches 400 at q=20, crosses cost exactly at q=10 (200=200), profit 0 (break-even). Axes labeled Quantity 0-20 and Amount 0-600, scales consistent; lines, markers, and dashed guide align with values. No gaps, no reversed axes, legends legible.
